concept.title: Battery management system
concept.shortdesc: The battery management system (BMS) in every Kivra Battery monitors the cells and protects them during charging.

conbody.p: The battery management system (BMS) is built into every Kivra Battery. It continuously monitors the temperature and voltage of the cells.
If the cells become too hot or too cold, the BMS automatically stops the charging process. This protects the cells from damage.
The BMS also balances the cells so that they wear evenly. Even wear extends the lifetime of the Kivra Battery.
Because of this protection, a Kivra Battery sometimes does not charge in winter, for example when it is stored in a garage. The low cell temperature causes the BMS to stop charging.
conbody.note: A Kivra Battery that does not charge because of cold conditions is not defective. The BMS is working as designed to protect the cells.
